defect.root_cause: Stock lane re-provisions each workspace with stock bugsinpy-checkout/bugsinpy-compile and the unmodified bugsinpy_run_test.sh. On this cluster that path resolves the cluster Python 3.11 interpreter, lacks the campaign's exact-runtimes python (e30-exact-runtimes/cpython-3.6.9), offline cache dispositions, prospective bindings and support-script normalization, so imports and interpreter identity diverge from the frozen baseline.

adapter.design: Monkey-patches ONLY runner._evaluate_bugsinpy after loading the stock evaluate_orion_real_problem_responses_v2 module. Response selection, uncheckable precheck, CANNOT_CHECK mapping, atomic writes, _extract_patch, the pass predicate (rc==0 AND no infrastructure-error markers, marker list replicated verbatim) and the orion.v2.task-evaluation.v1 record schema are the stock code paths. Only the provisioning lane changes: copy the campaign's baseline-verified evaluator_private/<task_id> workspace (workspace HEAD verified against expected_buggy_commit), apply the arm patch at the workspace root with the stock `git apply --whitespace=nowarn -` invocation, recompile with the frozen bugsinpy_project_runtime.compile_workspace (exact-runtime python, offline cache, prospective binding, registry), run the registered failing-test binding via execute_test_binding -- the same two functions the frozen baseline driver e30_baseline_driver_r11.py used.
adapter.workspace_copy_policy: copytree with symlinks=True (the frozen trees contain tracked-but-broken symlinks, e.g. black docs/*.md -> _build/generated/*; default follow-mode raises FileNotFoundError), excluding .orion-e30-env/.orion-e30-support/env/__pycache__/*.pyc.
adapter.workspace_restore_policy: After the copy, the tree is restored to the post-checkout state the frozen baseline compiled FROM: the baseline run left build products inside evaluator_private, and because `python -m pip` resolves the CWD as a site directory a stale egg-info there shadows the env's pinned install (observed on bugsinpy-tqdm-1: `pip show tqdm` returned Version 4.41.1 with Location=<workspace> instead of the pinned 4.44.1, finishing compile as CANNOT_CHECK_DEPENDENCY_VERSION_UNVERIFIED). Removed = exactly the repo-IGNORED paths (git ls-files -o -i --exclude-standard --directory: build/, dist/, *.egg-info/, __pycache__/, generated .c/.so, .pytest_cache, SYMLINK_CACHE.json, ...) plus a suffix sweep (.egg-info/.egg-link dirs; .pyc/.pyo/.so/.o/.egg files) for artifacts individual repos forgot to ignore (ansible-5 untracked lib/ansible_base.egg-info/). PRESERVED = tracked files with their frozen modifications (registered failing-test edits, e.g. tqdm tests_contrib.py 'M'; 34 tasks have 1 tracked change, 1 has 2, 5 have 0), the bugsinpy framework files (bugsinpy_requirements.txt / bugsinpy_run_test.sh / bugsinpy_setup.sh / bugsinpy_bug.info / bugsinpy_patchfile.info -- required, else compile finishes CANNOT_CHECK_MISSING_RUNTIME_FILES missing_files=[bugsinpy_requirements.txt, bugsinpy_run_test.sh]), and untracked new test files (registered failing tests added as new .py, e.g. ansible-4 test/units/playbook/test_collectionsearch.py, fastapi tests/*.py). Counts per task recorded in workspace_stale_build_artifacts_removed (0..90; pandas=90).
adapter.lane_environment: Per-evaluation isolated HOME/TMPDIR/XDG_CACHE_HOME/PIP_CACHE_DIR/PIP_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null/GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL mirror of the baseline driver per E30_R11_INFRASTRUCTURE_PREREGISTRATION lane_environment_policy. Hardenings added by the adapter, recorded in each evaluation record's isolated_environment field: (1) PYTHONPATH and PYTHONHOME are REMOVED from the lane environment -- the cluster login/batch environment exports the Python-3.11 bundle site-packages on PYTHONPATH, which the 3.6.9 frozen interpreter then imports (ModuleNotFoundError: dataclasses); a blanked PYTHONHOME additionally breaks Py_Initialize (no module 'encodings'), so the vars are popped, not blanked; (2) __pycache__/*.pyc are excluded from the workspace copy -- stale bytecode from evaluator_private carries the original absolute paths and shadows freshly collected test modules (pytest 'import file mismatch').
adapter.workspace_lifecycle: The copied workspace and lane directories are removed after the evaluation record is written; compile_receipt.json and test_receipt.json are kept per (arm,task) under run/confirmatory-r<N>/runs/<arm>/<task_id>/.
adapter.frozen_endpoints_touched: none. requests, frozen_tasks.json, response artifacts, predicates, and record schema are unmodified; the adapter only adds provenance fields (evaluation_lane, workspace_source, workspace_head*, workspace_stale_build_artifacts_removed, workspace_stale_build_artifacts_sample, workspace_dirty_after_restore, compile_status, test_binding_status, isolated_environment, workspace_cleanup).
